func: const r=msg.payload;if(r?.acknowledged!==true||r.matchedCount!==1)throw Error('Floor changed during calculation. Preview and retry.');msg.correction.floorSaved=true;const u=msg.correction.carUpdate;msg.payload=[u.filter,u.update];return msg;

name: Confirm correction
func: const r=msg.payload;if(r?.acknowledged!==true||r.matchedCount!==1)throw Error('Car changed during calculation. Floor saved; preview and retry car correction.');return {payload:{saved:true,floor:msg.correction.floorUpdate.preview,car:msg.correction.carUpdate.preview}};
